req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-038 requires that PUT /players/{playerId} returns HTTP 422 when called without a request body. The actual endpoint in the source is PUT /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. We need: (1) a negative test confirming 422 on missing body, (2) a positive test confirming 2xx when a valid body is provided, (3) a boundary test confirming that an empty JSON object {} (no required fields) also yields 422, and (4) additional tests to maximize mutation kill rate by asserting exact status codes and distinguishing 422 from neighboring codes like 400, 404, 200.

tests.name: test_put_player_no_body_returns_422
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database
PUT /players/squadnumber/10 is called with no request body
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with no body and no Content-Type header
expected: Status code is exactly 422, not 400, not 404, not 200
trace: R-PLAYER-038: system shall respond HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_no_body_returns_422():
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.status_code != 400
    assert response.status_code != 404
    assert response.status_code != 200
    assert response.status_code != 204

test_put_player_no_body_returns_422()

from main import app

def test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Kabir",
        "middleName": "Mary",
        "lastName": "Reddy",
        "dateOfBirth": "1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "team": "River Plate",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": False
    }
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/10', json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 204
    assert response.status_code != 422
    assert response.status_code != 400

test_put_player_valid_body_returns_204()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
